title: Audit compatibility in print preparations
description: Extend immutable PrintPreparation records with the exact compatibility result, confirmations, setup attestation, configuration, optional profile, and uncalibrated status used at generation.
acceptanceCriteria: A preparation snapshots the exact CompatibilityRequest/Result identity shown immediately before generation
The record references exact setup attestation, loading/configuration revisions, consumed confirmations, and optional profile identity
Uncalibrated preparations explicitly record zero correction and uncalibrated status
Later setup/profile edits cannot change historical preparation audit data
Keyboard browser tests verify explanation, confirmation, refusal, generation, and detail inspection

steps.details: Add versioned immutable compatibility audit fields to TASK-32 preparation inputs, including exact identities, ordered reasons, confirmations, and mode.
Require exact setup attestation and final reconfirmation records, then atomically snapshot them with the evaluated result at generation.
Show persistent compatible/incompatible/uncalibrated text and reason-by-reason actions using semantic headings and lists.
Assert displayed and saved results match, stale/missing confirmations refuse generation, historical records remain immutable, and zero-correction artifact checks pass.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; extend the existing immutable preparation audit and focused browser path.
The record audits software decisions and operator statements; it does not prove physical printing or placement.
Store normalized serializable values, not UI strings as decision state.
